messages:
maria_cs: FYI — ZenPort (main account: ZEN-42) just told us about two new squads onboarding next week: MLOps and Localization. They expect ~300k tokens/day initially, could double in 6 weeks. Can CS + Eng weigh dedicated vs burst options? :thinking_face:

jia_se: thanks. do we have expected qps or just tokens/day? any latency SLOs from them?

maria_cs: mostly batch ingestion + realtime QA. SLO is 200–300ms p95 for inference endpoints. QPS varies; peak bursts during ingest windows ~150 rps. Token sizes: embeddings ~512, inference prompts avg 1200 tokens.

thomas_sales: renewal in 60 days for ZenPort. this is a good expansion signal — sales + cs should sync before we propose Dedicated. any risks with their security needs? (they mentioned VPC)

akshay_zenport: @maria_cs correct. we'll be moving historical docs ingest next month. prefer VPC for compliance but open to dedicated hosted if numbers make sense. goal is predictable latency for search.

jia_se: ok. rough calc — if 300k tokens/day and avg 500 tokens/request that's ~600 req/day? wait math off.

maria_cs: quick calc from convo: two flavors — embeddings and chat. embeddings ~200k tokens/day, chat gen ~100k.

capacity-bot: Uploaded capacity estimate to this thread: https://redwood.internal/capacity/zenport-1712349999

jia_se: pasted my quick notes:
```
# conservative estimate
embeddings: 200k tokens/day
chat: 100k tokens/day
avg request tokens ~800
est peak qps ~ 80-150 (burst windows)
recommended: start with dedicated 2xA100 pods + autoscale to 4 during ingest
```

maria_cs: thanks. I'll schedule a customer call tomorrow to confirm ingest windows and share the dedicated vs burst cost delta.

thomas_sales: looping in finance for pricing + renewal uplift. @jia_se @maria_cs can you add a short one-pager (cost delta, SLA benefits) by EOD?

maria_cs: yep — will do. tagging @akshay_zenport so you see the plan. :thumbsup:

akshay_zenport: Great — appreciate the quick response. We'll have legal confirm VPC parameters but want to avoid major infra changes if dedicated covers it. 

capacity-bot: NOTE: flagged as expansion-opportunity in CRM (opportunity_id: CRM-7832).

maria_cs: moving to sync channel to set up call. closing thread here; will post notes after the customer call.
